feature: Backend connects to all mock servers at startup
steps: Open the mock server console at http://localhost:3031
Read the columns 'Status' and 'Connected clients' of 'Bahn 1', 'Bahn 2' and 'Weichen'
expected: 'Bahn 1', 'Bahn 2' and 'Weichen' are all 'Online' and each has at least 1 connected client

feature: Page structure follows the UI mockup
steps: Open the app
Read the page structure
expected: The page has a header with the title 'Gartenbahn', a card 'Gartenbahn-Ansicht' with a track graphic, a card 'Control Panel' with a train selection, a stop list, a Start button and a status badge, and a button 'Alle Strecken zurücksetzen'; there is no login or account form

feature: Visual style follows the UI mockup
steps: Open the app
Take a screenshot of the page
expected: The page uses the neutral shadcn/ui-like style of the mockup: light background, white cards with thin grey borders and rounded corners, a dark primary button and segmented train tabs

feature: Track graphic in the preview
steps: Open the app
Take a screenshot of the track graphic in the card 'Gartenbahn-Ansicht'
expected: The preview shows a drawn track layout with an outer loop, a siding next to the main line, switches where tracks branch, labelled stops and a dead-end calibration point

feature: Exactly two trains
steps: Open the app
Read the train selection in the control panel
expected: Exactly two trains can be selected: 'Bahn 1' and 'Bahn 2'

feature: First setup asks for the first train
steps: Open the app
Read the page without clicking anything
expected: A popup or dialog asks the user to place the first train ('Bahn 1') on the calibration point and offers a button to confirm this

feature: First setup shows the switch hint
steps: Open the app
Read the page without clicking anything
expected: The page shows a hint that the user should check whether the switches are set correctly

feature: Controls are locked until the first setup is completed
steps: Open the app
Without confirming anything in the calibration dialog, try to click the Start button
Try to click 'Haltestelle hinzufügen'
Read the status badge and the stop list
expected: The Start button is disabled or cannot be reached, no stop can be added, and the status badge still shows 'Gestoppt'

feature: Confirming the first train starts its calibration
steps: Open the app
In the calibration dialog, click the button that confirms that the first train is on the calibration point
Wait 20 seconds, then take a new accessibility snapshot
Read the calibration dialog
expected: The dialog now asks the user to place the second train ('Bahn 2') on the calibration point

feature: A second frontend shows the current setup step
steps: Open the app
Open the app URL in a second browser tab
Read the calibration dialog in the second tab
expected: The second tab directly shows the current step, i.e. the request to place the second train ('Bahn 2') on the calibration point, not the request for the first train

feature: Completing the setup in one frontend completes it in all frontends
steps: Open the app
Open the app URL in a second browser tab
In the second tab, click the button that confirms that the second train is on the calibration point
Wait 20 seconds, then take a new accessibility snapshot
Read the page in the second tab
Switch to the first tab without reloading it
Read the page in the first tab
expected: In both tabs the calibration dialog is gone and the Start button is enabled

feature: Both trains are shown after the setup
steps: Open the app
Take a screenshot of the track graphic
expected: Markers for both 'Bahn 1' and 'Bahn 2' are shown on the track

feature: Calibration uses the slow calibration speed
steps: Open the mock server console at http://localhost:3031
Read the column 'Applied speed changes (oldest first)' of 'Bahn 1' and 'Bahn 2'
expected: For both trains the history contains a low speed greater than 0 (the calibration speed) that is later followed by speed 0

feature: The first train waits at the calibration waiting point
steps: Open the mock server console at http://localhost:3031
Read the column 'Applied speed changes (oldest first)' and the column 'Speed (0-255)' of 'Bahn 1'
expected: After the calibration speed, the history of 'Bahn 1' contains a higher speed (the drive to the calibration waiting point) and then speed 0; the current speed of 'Bahn 1' is 0

feature: The second train stays at the calibration point
steps: Open the mock server console at http://localhost:3031
Read the column 'Applied speed changes (oldest first)' and the column 'Speed (0-255)' of 'Bahn 2'
expected: The history of 'Bahn 2' contains only the calibration speed and speed 0 (no higher speed), and its current speed is 0

feature: Live status of each train
steps: Open the app
If the status badge shows 'In Fahrt', click the Stop button
Select 'Bahn 1' and read its status
Select 'Bahn 2' and read its status
expected: For each train the app shows that a connection to the train exists and shows its current speed (0 while the trains are stopped)

feature: Edit the stops of a train
steps: Open the app
If the status badge shows 'In Fahrt', click the Stop button
Click 'Alle Strecken zurücksetzen'
Select 'Bahn 1'
Click 'Haltestelle hinzufügen' three times
Set the first stop to the first option, the second stop to the second option and the third stop to the third option of the stop selection
Click the remove button of the second stop
Read the stop list of 'Bahn 1'
expected: The stop selection offers the stops of the track layout; after removing, exactly the stops chosen first and third remain, numbered 1 and 2 in this order

feature: Any number of stops, the same stop several times
steps: Open the app
If the status badge shows 'In Fahrt', click the Stop button
Click 'Alle Strecken zurücksetzen'
Select 'Bahn 2'
Click 'Haltestelle hinzufügen' four times
Click 'Haltestelle hinzufügen' four more times
Set stop 1 and stop 3 to the same stop
Read the stop list of 'Bahn 2'
expected: All 8 stops are listed for 'Bahn 2' without an error or limit message, and stop 1 and stop 3 show the same stop

feature: Each train has its own stop list
steps: Open the app
If the status badge shows 'In Fahrt', click the Stop button
Click 'Alle Strecken zurücksetzen'
Select 'Bahn 1' and click 'Haltestelle hinzufügen' once
Select 'Bahn 2' and click 'Haltestelle hinzufügen' twice
Select 'Bahn 1' and read its stop list
expected: 'Bahn 1' has exactly 1 stop; the 2 stops added for 'Bahn 2' do not appear in the list of 'Bahn 1'

feature: Reset all routes removes all stops
steps: Open the app
If the status badge shows 'In Fahrt', click the Stop button
Select 'Bahn 1' and click 'Haltestelle hinzufügen'
Select 'Bahn 2' and click 'Haltestelle hinzufügen'

Select 'Bahn 2' and read its stop list
expected: Both trains have no stops anymore

feature: Start locks the editing
steps: Open the app

feature: Start makes the locomotives drive
